originalTitle: 'I've had people eating cat food': Rising cost of living top of mind for US voters
summary: The BBC's Clive Myrie travelled to North Caroline where voters voiced their frustrations ahead of midterm elections.
content:
As Americans prepare to head to the polls for crucial midterm elections that will determine control of Congress, surveys suggest the issue of rising prices is central to how many people will decide their vote.

The BBC's Clive Myrie visited North Carolina where he spoke to voters about the issue ahead of the elections on Tuesday.

Video produced by: Janet Heaney and Davy McIlveen

Follow our coverage of the US midterm elections here.
chineseTitle: “我有人吃猫粮”：生活成本上升是美国选民最关心的问题
chineseSummary: BBC 的克莱夫·迈里 (Clive Myrie) 前往北卡罗来纳州，那里的选民在中期选举前表达了他们的不满。
chineseContent:
当美国人准备参加将决定国会控制权的关键中期选举时，调查显示，物价上涨问题对于有多少人决定投票至关重要。

BBC 的克莱夫·迈里 (Clive Myrie) 访问了北卡罗来纳州，他在周二的选举前向选民谈论了这一问题。

视频制作：Janet Heaney 和 Davy McIveen

请在此关注我们对美国中期选举的报道。
